lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Sales of “Grand Theft Auto VI” are skyrocketing, as gamers’ insatiable appetite for the series continues, The Associated Press reports.

The Russian Embassy alleged Moscow had repeatedly warned foreign nationals, including diplomatic staff, about the dangers of remaining in or traveling to Ukraine, adding that “full responsibility for any potential negative consequences lies entirely with the Austrian side,” Kyiv Independent reports.
Members of Parliament have voted to pass the 2026 federal budget in the House of Commons, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
